chemicalData.Chemical Description: High purity organic solvent for industrial cleaning, degreasing, and chemical synthesis.
chemicalData.Handling Precautions: Ensure local exhaust ventilation. Keep away from heat, sparks, open flames, and hot surfaces.
chemicalData.First Aid Measures: In case of skin contact, rinse with plenty of water. If inhaled, remove to fresh air.
